name: @zframes/data-primitives
description: zframes provider transport primitives: the shared fetchJson/fetchText transport (UA, proxy rewrite, abort, optional Zod validation), the TtlCache (TTL + in-flight dedup + stale-on-error + opt-in persist), quote-aware CSV row parsing for the CSV-published official sources, and the keyless USD FX chain a local-currency provider converts through. React-free.
author: Zentry
